description: Points a subdomain (for example shop.example.com) at a 3DMockups online store hosted on Vercel, so the seller can keep another website on the root domain. Every other record stays as it is.
variableDescription: target: the Vercel host name the subdomain points to (per project, for example f1484cc966e27e11.vercel-dns-016.com). Ownership TXT records, when Vercel asks for them, are applied at the root domain with the verify group of the 3dmockups.app storefront template.
